item.title: NHL Rumors: How the Canadiens Can Make a Patrik Laine Trade Work
item.description: The Montreal Canadiens can make a Patrik Laine trade work, but it is going to take a realistic blueprint. Insider Chris Johnston’s view is that at an $8.7 million cap hit, Montreal likely has to retain money, attach value, or do a bit of both to get a deal over the line. The good news for Kent Hughes is the timing helps, because once the Olympic freeze lifts and teams start thinking in cap accrual terms, Laine becomes easier to fit than his full-season number suggests. item.title: Insider: 'Conversation' Definitely Coming for Maple Leafs & Morgan Rielly
item.description: As the longest-serving Toronto Maple Leaf, no player has seen more of the drama and playoff failures surrounding this team in the Auston Matthews Era than Morgan Rielly. item.title: Kings Forward Kevin Fiala Stretchered Off Ice in Switzerland's Loss to Canada
item.description: It was an ugly situation in Milan today, as late in Canada's 5-1 victory over Switzerland, Swiss (and LA Kings) forward Kevin Fiala was seriously injured when he went down awkwardly in a collision with Tom Wilson. He had to be taken off the ice on a stretcher. Kevin Fiala leaves the game after Tom Wilson and Kevin Fiala get tangled (not country locked) pic.twitter.com/ZaWUeyelcS— bnpeki 🇨🇦 Matthew Knies Enjoyer (@bnpeki) February 13, 2026 It was Fiala's lower left leg that took the brunt of it.
